text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Hill Crescent, between Markham Road and Scarborough Golf Club Road. Staff's assessment indicates that the criteria as set out in the updated Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Hill Crescent.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Hill Crescent, between Markham Road and Scarborough Golf Club Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway for the installation of 14 speed humps on Hill Crescent, between Markham Road and Scarborough Golf Club Road, generally as shown on Attachments 5, 6 and 7, Drawings TC-302, TC-303, and TC-304, to the report (June 25, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services. 3. Subject to approval of Recommendations 1 and 2 above, reduced the speed limit from 40 kilometres per hour to 30 kilometres per hour on Hill Crescent, between Markham Road and Scarborough Golf Club Road, in conjunction with the installation of speed humps.
